name: nmr-companion
description: Native Windows NMR workbench and shared MCP tools for organic evidence and signed relaxation analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Shared NMR projects for people and agents.
interface.longDescription: Prerelease: a native Qt Widgets Windows workbench and shared MCP projects, qualified 1D and processed COSY/HSQC imports, structures and evidence, yield/recovery, explicit conditions, T1/T2 fits and revision-bound exports. Instrument, model and host qualification is recorded separately.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me analyse NMR data with explicit units, provenance and editable results.
